questions.q: What is the capital of San Marino?
questions.why: It sits on top of Monte Titano.

questions.q: Which country completely surrounds San Marino?
questions.why: It lies near Rimini.

questions.q: What is San Marino often called?
questions.why: Its traditional founding date is 301.

questions.q: Which stonemason saint is said to have founded San Marino?
questions.why: He fled persecution from the island of Rab.

questions.q: What is San Marino's currency?
questions.why: It mints its own euro coins.

questions.q: How many heads of state does San Marino have at a time?
questions.why: They are called Captains Regent.

questions.q: For how long do the Captains Regent serve?
questions.why: New ones take office in April and October.

questions.q: Which mountain does San Marino's old town stand on?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which American President was made an honorary citizen of San Marino?
questions.why: He wrote back to thank them in 1861.

questions.q: Which French leader offered San Marino more land, which it turned down?
questions.why: It feared losing its independence.

questions.q: What is San Marino's parliament called?
questions.why: It has 60 members.

questions.q: Which Italian patriot found refuge in San Marino in 1849?
questions.why: San Marino later stayed independent of unified Italy.

questions.q: How many 'castelli' or districts is San Marino divided into?
questions.why: Each has its own council.

questions.q: Which three towers on Monte Titano appear on the flag?
wrong: Torre del Mangia, Garisenda and Asinelli
questions.why: They are also called the First, Second and Third Towers.

questions.q: In which year did San Marino's women gain the vote?
questions.why: They could stand for office from 1973.

questions.q: Which motor-racing event once took its name from San Marino?
questions.why: It was held at Imola in Italy.

questions.q: What is the official language of San Marino?
questions.why: A local Romagnol dialect is also spoken.

questions.q: Which cable car links Borgo Maggiore to the old town?
questions.why: It climbs Monte Titano.

questions.q: How large is San Marino?
questions.why: It is the fifth-smallest country in the world.

questions.q: What is San Marino famous for selling to collectors?
questions.why: They bring in tourist income.

questions.q: Which nearby Italian seaside city do most visitors come from?
questions.why: It is about 25 km away.

questions.q: Which national football team is famous for rarely winning?
questions.why: Its first competitive win came in 2024 against Liechtenstein.

questions.q: Which layered cake is a San Marino speciality?
questions.why: It is named after the three towers.

questions.q: Which circuit near the border hosts the San Marino MotoGP?
questions.why: It is named after Marco Simoncelli.

questions.q: What is the national day of San Marino?
questions.why: It marks the founding of the republic.

questions.q: In which European football match did San Marino score after eight seconds in 1993?
questions.why: Davide Gualtieri scored the goal.

questions.q: Which San Marino shooter won the country's first Olympic medal, in 2021?
questions.why: She won bronze in trap.

questions.q: Which museum in San Marino displays medieval weapons?
questions.why: It is in the Cesta tower.

questions.q: Which basilica in the old town holds the saint's relics?
questions.why: It was rebuilt in the 1800s.

questions.q: How many medals did San Marino win at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics?
questions.why: It was the smallest country to win a medal.
